summary: Interstate Power and Light Company, an Alliant Energy utility subsidiary, filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a $500 million offering of 5.100% senior debentures due September 30, 2031. Priced at 99.889% of par, the deal yields $499.445 million gross and $496.445 million net after a 0.600% underwriting discount, with settlement on or about August 21, 2026. Interest pays semi-annually each March 30 and September 30, beginning March 30, 2027. The notes are unsecured senior obligations, unlisted, issued in minimum $2,000 denominations, callable before and at par from August 30, 2031. This is an ordinary investment-grade debt takedown, not a special situation; watch credit spreads and tax-credit-event redemption terms.
